privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: Game Shelf is a small community project. This page says plainly what we keep about you.

stored.email: Your email address, used to sign you in and to send you a password reset link.
stored.name: Your display name. Other members see it next to the games you own and the notes you write.
stored.activity: The games you add, and the ratings and comments you write.

handlers.turnstile: Cloudflare Turnstile checks that a visitor is a person, on the sign in and sign up forms.
handlers.resend: Resend sends our account emails (such as the welcome email and password resets). It receives your email address and display name for that purpose.

privacy.choices: You can change your display name any time on the Me page. To delete your account, ask the group admin.
